commands.title: Measure rebuild and compile cost
commands.inputs: A clean source file and a Cargo scenario.
commands.mutation: Temporarily edits the selected source and restores it. Writes measurement data.
commands.build: Needs Cargo and the required target bind. Builds run serially.

commands.title: Profile desktop or headless simulation
commands.inputs: Host options and a profiling scenario.
commands.outputs: Profile bundle with traces and summaries.
commands.mutation: Runs the host and writes profiling artifacts.
commands.build: Needs the target bind and profile tools. Reuses binaries when requested.

commands.title: Measure engine architecture and source ownership
commands.inputs: Workspace source and the consolidation ledger.
commands.mutation: Reads source and writes requested reports.

commands.title: Check offscreen render prerequisites
commands.inputs: Host Vulkan loader and driver paths.
commands.mutation: Reads host capabilities. Does not launch the game.
commands.build: Uses Python only; an actual capture proves render support.
